{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Rock| type2=Psychic| trainername=Liza| pokemonname=Lunatone| jtrainername=ラン| jpokemonname=ルナトーン| tmtrainername=Lan| tmpokemonname=Lunatone| image=[[File:Liza Lunatone.png|250px]]| caption=Liza's Lunatone in the {{aniseries|PTS}}| location=Unknown| gender=Gender unknown| ability={{a|Levitate}}| epnum=AG099| epname=It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!| prevonum=337| noevo=incap| current=[[Party|With Liza]]| |java1=[[Chie Satō]] |enva1= }} '''Liza's Lunatone''' (Japanese: '''ランのルナトーン''' ''Lan's Lunatone'') is a Pokémon owned by [[Tate and Liza|Liza]] in the {{pkmn|games}}, {{pkmn|animation}}, and {{pkmn|manga}}. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== ===={{aniseries|AG}}==== [[File:Liza Lunatone Levitate.png|thumb|220px|left|Activating {{a|Levitate}}]] Lunatone is the Pokémon Liza uses in all Gym battles. It first appeared in ''[[AG099|It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!]]'', where it faced off against [[Tate's Solrock]]. Lunatone was dominating the battle until Solrock launched a {{m|Solar Beam}}. However, Lunatone's {{m|Ice Beam}} {{status|Freeze|froze}} Solrock and defeated it. It was later used to battle {{TRT}}, once again using Ice Beam to freeze them. In ''[[AG100|Solid as a Solrock]]'', Lunatone was sent out alongside Solrock in a [[Double Battle]] against [[Ash's Pikachu]] and {{AP|Swellow}}. Lunatone and Solrock had the advantage at first since they dominated their opponents, but an accidental clash of Solar Beam and Ice Beam caused Tate and Liza to fight. Additional collisions caused the siblings to continue their fighting, which gave Swellow the advantage to attack unnoticed the first time. Team Rocket interrupted the battle and stole Lunatone along with Solrock, but they were both rescued with the combined efforts of Pikachu and Swellow. The battle was continued outside afterwards. Once again, Lunatone was able to dominate the battle, by blocking Pikachu's attacks with {{m|Light Screen}}. Pikachu's and Swellow's use of {{DL|Moves not in the Pokémon games|Thunder Armor}} allowed them to defeat Lunatone and earned Ash the {{badge|Mind}}. ====Personality and characteristics==== Very little is known about Lunatone's personality except for the fact that it doesn't get into arguments with Tate's Solrock unlike their Trainers sometimes. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|rock|psychic|Liza Lunatone {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Tackle|1=Psychic|2=Ice Beam|3=Light Screen}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=Tackle|1=Psychic|2=Ice Beam|3=Light Screen}}}} {{anmov|normal|Tackle|AG099|It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!}} {{anmov|psychic|Psychic|AG099|It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!}} {{anmov|ice|Ice Beam|AG099|It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!}} {{anmov|psychic|Light Screen|AG100|Solid as a Solrock}} {{anmov/f|psychic}} ===GOTCHA!=== Liza's Lunatone briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the games== ===In the [[core series]]=== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s}}''' |gen=3 |ndex=0337 |pokemon=Lunatone |level=42 |type1=Rock|type2=Psychic |ability=Levitate |move1=Light Screen|move1type=Psychic |move2=Psychic|move2type=Psychic |move3=Hypnosis|move3type=Psychic |move4=Calm Mind|move4type=Psychic}} {{Pokémon |caption='''{{game|Emerald}}

It appeared in ''[[PS228|I'm Always Grumpig First Thing in the Morning II]]'', where it was traveling with its Trainer on [[Mt. Pyre]]. Lunatone was used in conjunction with Solrock against the {{tc|Team Magma Grunt}}s that were aiming to steal the [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s. Despite their best efforts, the Grunts were only illusions created by {{tc|Magma Admin}} [[Blaise]], who easily got past his opponents and stole the orbs. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|rock|psychic|{{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Tate Solrock Liza Lunatone Cosmic Power|1=Liza Lunatone Rock Slide}} Adventures.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Cosmic Power|1=Rock Slide}}}} {{anmov|psychic|Cosmic Power|PS229|You Can Fight Day or Night With Lunatone & Solrock}} {{anmov|rock|Rock Slide|PS229|You Can Fight Day or Night With Lunatone & Solrock}} {{anmov/f|psychic}} ==In the TCG== [[File:TateLizaCelestialStorm148a.jpg|thumb|200px|Lunatone]] Lunatone appears in the card [[Tate & Liza (Celestial Storm 148)]]. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Lunatone is the first Pokémon belonging to a Gym Leader to activate its [[Ability]] in {{aniseries|PTS}}. * Lunatone and {{TP|Tate|Solrock}} are the only Pokémon in [[Pokémon Adventures]] to have used the move {{m|Cosmic Power}}. ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Lunatone}} * [[Tate's Solrock]] {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Gym Leaders' Pokémon|Lunatone]] [[Category:Ruby and Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Emerald characters]] [[Category:Black 2 and White 2 characters]] [[Category:Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters (Pokémon)]] [[Category:Gender unknown characters (Pokémon)|Lunatone]] [[es:Lunatone de Liza/Leti]] [[it:Lunatone di Pat]]
